name: omni-0-mini-preview
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM2-1.7B-Instruct (config.json max_position_embeddings 8192). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-11-04. A DARE-TIES merge of four domain experts (science, technology, engineering, math) that are themselves finetunes of HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM2-1.7B-Instruct; identical tensor set to the base (1.711B, 24 layers, hidden 2048, 32 KV heads x head_dim 64), so this is a merge artifact and not a new architecture. Recorded as a contender because the card's STEM table prints an 'Omni' column and a 'Base' column side by side on all 11 rows. Read it as a narrow domain gain: +7.6pp on the 11-row average, but the merge LOSES MATH (15.66 vs 16.12, the card bolds the base) and only edges HumanEval (31.71 vs 29.88). The same table prints Llama 3.2 3B at 38.33 and Gemma 3 4B at 43.91 average, both above this model, so 'state of the art' in the card's prose means 'state of the art among the card's own optimization techniques', not among small models. The card publishes no eval harness, no sample counts and no variance, and its expert table's per-domain 'Improvement' percentages are relative to per-domain base averages that are not the same as the base's full-benchmark numbers - only the merged table is recorded here. Repo created 2025-06-27. Paper still unreleased.
